name: Diamond Push-Up
summary: A narrow-hand push-up that shifts the emphasis to the triceps while still working the chest and shoulders.
setup: Start in a push-up position with hands under your chest.
Bring your hands together so the thumbs and index fingers form a diamond or triangle.
Extend your legs, brace abs and squeeze glutes into a straight line.
If it is too hard, drop to your knees or place your hands on a bench.
execution: Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your ribs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.
Look at the floor slightly ahead so your neck stays neutral.
mistakes: Elbows flaring: keep them close to your sides.
Hips sagging: squeeze glutes and brace the abs.
Wrist discomfort: set hands slightly wider apart than a full diamond, or use fists.
Cutting the range: lower until your chest is near your hands, or use an incline.
